name: Geothermal (flash and binary cycle)
principle: Hot water or steam from wells drives a turbine directly (dry steam, flash at 200 °C and above) or heats a secondary fluid in an organic Rankine cycle (binary, 110 to under 200 °C). NREL's 2024 baseline sizes a hydrothermal flash plant at 40 MWe, 225 °C, 2.5 km, and a binary plant at 30 MWe, 175 °C, 1.5 km.
